name: UV-damage repair: nucleotide excision and translesion synthesis
reason: GG-NER incision and gap filling, POLH translesion synthesis, UV protection and hallmark DNA repair all address UV-induced DNA lesions.

name: Plasma membrane remodeling, blebbing and repair
reason: Blebbing, membrane repair, Ca-activated phospholipid scrambling (TMEM16F) and cell volume form a plasma membrane dynamics core; autophagosome docking and mito-ER tethering are organelle contact topics that do not fit.

name: Fucose metabolism and fucosylated (Lewis) glycan synthesis
reason: Fucose metabolism/catabolism and fucosylated oligosaccharide (Lewis antigen) biosynthesis are one glycobiology theme.

name: PI3K-AKT-PTEN signaling
reason: AKT targets, PTEN stability/localization, TORC2 and oncogenic AKT1 E17K are all core PI3K-AKT axis; ERBB2:ERBB3 is the upstream PI3K-activating receptor.

name: Liver development, regeneration and hepatocyte proliferation
reason: All members concern hepatocyte differentiation, proliferation, survival and liver morphogenesis/regeneration.

name: Viral mRNA expression and evasion of host translational defenses
reason: Viral mRNA synthesis/translation and reinitiation plus viral blockade of PKR, IFIT and host mRNA processing are all virus-host control of gene expression (largely influenza).

name: Actin cytoskeleton dynamics and focal adhesion linkage
reason: Actin nucleation, capping, severing, bundling and crosslinking dominate, with ILK-PINCH-parvin/integrin adhesion linkage; nuclear migration and erythrocyte maturation are minor odd members.

name: Survival and maintenance of developmental mesenchymal cells
reason: Nephron mesenchymal stem cell maintenance and suppression of mesenchymal/developmental apoptosis share a theme; TGF-beta2 production is a related minor member.

name: IGF signaling and skeletal growth/mineralization
reason: IGF/peptide hormone responses and hormone-mediated apoptosis link to chondrocyte development and bone mineralization through the GH-IGF axis driving skeletal growth.

name: Regulation of cardiac contractility and hypertrophic adaptation
reason: All members regulate heart contraction force, rate, relaxation, sarcomere organization or cardiomyocyte growth/adaptation.

name: Golgi organization, ribbon assembly and mitotic disassembly
reason: All four concern Golgi structure, ribbon formation and its reorganization/disassembly.

name: Axon guidance (semaphorin, ephrin, netrin, Slit-Robo, L1)
reason: Every member is an axon guidance cue/receptor pathway or axon extension, fasciculation and sprouting process.

name: NTF3 signaling through TRKB/TRKC receptors
reason: NTF3 activation of NTRK2/NTRK3 and downstream PI3K, PLCG1 and RAS branches.

name: Presynaptic vesicle cycle and clathrin-mediated endocytosis
reason: Synaptic vesicle recycling, endocytosis, clathrin coat assembly/disassembly and active zone organization; annular gap junction internalization is clathrin-dependent, neuron maturation is a minor outlier.

name: BCL-2 family control of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization
reason: BID activation, BAK oligomerization and regulation of MOMP/cytochrome c release are the intrinsic apoptosis mitochondrial step.

name: APC-T cell costimulation and dendritic cell regulation
reason: TCR-MHC contact, costimulation, CD4 T cell proliferation, immunoregulatory receptor interactions and dendritic cell activation/differentiation all concern the APC-T cell interface.

name: NK and T cell cytotoxic lymphocyte signatures
reason: All are blood transcription modules enriched in NK cells or T cells/activation.

name: Skeletal muscle differentiation and neuromuscular junction/sarcolemma
reason: Myogenesis, muscle fiber differentiation, AChR clustering, NMJ assembly and the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex with its basement membrane proteoglycans (agrin, perlecan).

name: Proton transport and organelle acidification (V-ATPase)
reason: V-ATPase assembly, lysosomal/Golgi acidification, proton transport, pH reduction and carbonic anhydrase CO2 hydration all concern pH regulation.

name: Lysophospholipid (S1P/LPA) receptor signaling
reason: S1P and LPA receptor signaling form the core, VEGFR2 proliferation connects via sphingosine kinase/S1P in endothelium; regulation of phosphatidylinositol biosynthesis does not fit.

name: Presynaptic G-protein modulation of calcium channels and release
reason: Gi/o-coupled presynaptic inhibition, Gbeta-gamma inhibition of VGCCs, GIRK activation, presynaptic Ca2+ and kainate receptor function all regulate presynaptic transmitter release.

name: Tooth development and enamel/dentin mineralization
reason: Amelogenesis, dentinogenesis, tooth eruption and enamel mineralization; FAM20C post-translational phosphorylation of enamel/dentin matrix proteins fits.

name: Negative regulation of complement activation
reason: All members concern regulation/inhibition of the complement cascade and complement-mediated humoral immunity.

name: Ketone body and mitochondrial malate/pyruvate metabolism
reason: Ketogenesis/ketolysis and the HCAR2 ketone receptor plus malate, oxaloacetate and pyruvate metabolism; linked by hepatic mitochondrial fasting metabolism where oxaloacetate diversion drives ketogenesis.

name: tRNA aminoacylation (cytosolic and mitochondrial)
reason: All members are aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase charging and fidelity processes.

name: TLR/IL-1R TRAF6-TAK1 signaling to IKK, JNK and p38
reason: MyD88/IRAK and TRIF/RIP1 routes to TAK1 and IKK, K63 ubiquitination, TBK1-IRF3 and JNK/p38 activation are the innate receptor kinase cascade.

name: IL-12/IL-23 and IL-10 cytokine signaling
reason: IL-12 and IL-23 signaling with IL-10 signaling, linked as JAK-STAT cytokines where IL-10 directly restrains the IL-12/IL-23 axis.

name: Floor plate Hedgehog and netrin signaling in axon guidance
reason: Floor plate development, Hedgehog signaling and netrin-1/A-P axon guidance are linked by the floor plate as the Shh and netrin source guiding commissural axons.

name: Neuron versus glial fate specification
reason: Neuron fate, glial fate, oligodendrocyte, astrocyte and Schwann cell differentiation control, with Notch (NOTCH2NL) and p75NTR in neural progenitor regulation.

name: Lung and branching-organ epithelial-mesenchymal morphogenesis
reason: Lung development dominates; salivary, lacrimal, mammary, pancreatic, kidney, trachea and limb bud members share epithelial-mesenchymal (FGF10/SHH) branching morphogenesis; hyperoxia, ductus arteriosus and HNF module are minor outliers.

name: Chaperone-mediated protein folding and aggregate control
reason: De novo and ER protein folding, refolding, ATPase activation of chaperones, aggrephagy and inclusion body control are proteostasis.

name: Mitochondrial amino acid conjugation of xenobiotic acids
reason: Glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate (amide metabolism, mitochondrial) form the core; dicarboxylic acid biosynthesis and amino acid metabolism regulation are loose.

name: Muscarinic acetylcholine receptor signaling and cAMP attenuation
reason: Muscarinic receptors via Gi (adenylate cyclase inhibition) and Gq/PLC (Ca2+/CaM-PDE1), plus cAMP catabolism and negative cAMP/PKA regulation.

name: Adherens junction assembly and cadherin adhesion
reason: Calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion and adherens junction assembly/localization.

name: Methionine-SAM cycle, choline and carnitine methyl metabolism
reason: Methionine/SAM metabolism and its inborn errors, methionine salvage, choline catabolism (betaine methyl donor) and carnitine synthesis from methylated lysine are linked through methyl-group/one-carbon metabolism.

name: MECP2 regulation and neuronal gene transcription
reason: All four are MECP2 pathways.

name: Mitotic spindle positioning and orientation
reason: Spindle localization, orientation, astral microtubules and spindle assembly.

name: Photoreceptor cilium and outer segment biogenesis
reason: Ciliogenesis, basal body anchoring, transition zone and ARL13B-INPP5E ciliary trafficking with photoreceptor outer segment morphogenesis/maintenance; organ identity is a minor outlier.

name: IGF signaling and FOXO-mediated transcription
reason: IGF responses with FOXO cell cycle and hormone-mediated apoptotic transcription are the IGF-PI3K-FOXO axis.

name: Phosphate homeostasis and tissue mineralization
reason: Phosphate transport/homeostasis, PTH response and disorders of ectopic calcification (SLC20A2, ABCC6) or enamel/bone mineralization.
